items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: So you can see why I'm very fond of Bobby Hackett. He's got two guys I like all wrapped in him, you know.

ctx.x: And there was another great (unintelligible) Joe Smith. He had a beautiful sound you know. Played beautiful. Bobby Hackett reminds me of him more today than any of my -- certainly has got a beautiful sound right there.

And then he plays like Louis too. And when he plays the organ, people will say Louis. His brother Hackett's got this beautiful sound. They say Joe Smith doesn't sound like that. So you can see why I'm very fond of Bobby Hackett. He's got two guys I like all wrapped in him, you know.
